title: SessionNotice
description: Something the agent, a hook or a command said that is not a message, a tool or a turn — a warning, a banner, an automation failing, a retry. One event covers every such case (plan 27): the adapter of the engine picks the `kind`, never the client. Carried in the replay and in the history (`transcript.appended`), the same as any other event of the conversation.

noticeId.description: Stable live and in the history — the id the engine itself gave the message, when it has one. What lets a client replace a notice rather than duplicate it.

kind.description: The canonical kind of the notice, decided by the adapter of the engine: `command.output`, `agent.info`, `agent.notification`, `agent.stopping`, `model.switched`, `model.refused`, `request.retrying`, `usage.limited`, `turn.failed`, `compaction.failed`, `auth.failed`, `unknown`. **Open**: a kind the client does not know is drawn as the generic line, never an error (ADR-025).

level.description: How prominent the line reads. Not the same scale as a tool's `status` or a turn's `outcome` — a notice is never itself succeeded or failed.

messageKey.description: Set when the text is ours: an i18n key the client translates (`sessions.notice.modelSwitched`), paired with `params`. Mutually exclusive with `text` in practice — a notice carries one or the other, never both.

params.description: The parameters `messageKey` takes — in the domain each value is a string, a number or a boolean; the generator's open-object subset cannot bound the value type further, so this is carried as a generic open object. Absent without a `messageKey`.

text.description: Set when the text is the agent's, a hook's or a command's own — never ours to translate, and never trusted: shown as plain text, cut to `maxLength` with `truncated: true` when it was. Mutually exclusive with `messageKey` in practice.

truncated.description: Set when `text` was cut to fit the limit. Absent otherwise, and absent without `text`.

subject.description: What the notice is about, normalised — the command, the hook, what ran it.

origin.description: The engine and its own, opaque name for whatever this notice came from — diagnosis, and the text of a `kind: 'unknown'` line.

parentToolUseId.description: Set when this comes from a subagent: the `toolUseId` of the `agent` call that opened it. Absent on the main conversation.

at.description: When the entry was written, ISO 8601 — on the events of the history only, from the transcript's own `timestamp`. Absent live, where the frame's `ts` is the clock.
